description:
A third-year student from the M.M.R. Vocational School, who nevertheless has the appearance of a small child.
Despite the fact she is childlike in both her demeanor and personal hobbies, she utterly despises being referred to as "kid" or "little girl".
As a senior, she feels obligated to take care of her fellow students who are younger than her, and spares no effort in doing so.

lines.text: Gotta hurry before everyone sees it... Mmm, delicious!
I may be a little older now, but it's not the end of the world if I eat sweets once in a while, right?
Naru, say aaaahhhhh! Let's see if you have any cavities.
Would you like to have lunch together? We don't have to tell the others.
I love these snacks, especially the ones you give me, Teacher!
Naru and I will protect you, Teacher. Pinky promise!
When will we have time to self-study, Teacher?
Why don't we all go downtown if there's nothing else that needs doing? I heard there's a store where you can buy as much candy as you want.
AP class is mandatory at the Tactic Academy, so are EMP performance tests... I don't understand any of this...
Penguins aren't usually afraid of people. Maybe that's why Naru and I have grown so close.
Even with the school, you're still doing the opposite of what's intended, ya know what I mean?
I'm Rei, a senior from a vocational school! Nice to meet you, Teacher!
The penguin colony has become more resilient.
I'll grow a little taller with this, right?
We'll protect you, Teacher!
For me? Really?
Woooow...
I'll split it with Naru. Hehe!
You're the best, Teacher.
You're not going away, are you, Teacher?
Are you hungry, Teacher? I can always share my snacks with you.
Now that I'm a senior in school, I needa to stay sharp.
What do we do now?
I'm going!
Time for some extracurricular activities!
Let's go, Naru!
I've got this!
Let's show them what penguins are made of!
Hurry up, Naru...
Argh...
C'mon, a little more!
Me! Pick me!
Why don't you pick on someone your own size?!
Ready, set, GO!
We did it!
Gotcha!
Did you see that?
Ugh!
Kyaa!
Hiccup!
I'm sorry. Hiccup... I'll be leaving early...
Did you see that, Teacher? We won!
